concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-apple-pay-apple-pay-certificate-ios]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured iOS merchant-owned Apple Pay payment-processing certificate setup and renewal guide, with separate test/live IDs, web-service-user upload and approximately four-hour certificate overlap.
warnings: Certificate use, an authorized example and Customer Area setup do not establish current merchant eligibility, capture, settlement or payout.
The roughly four-hour old-certificate overlap follows Apple activation; old-KeyID observation during rollout is not itself setup failure.
